ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.

2. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   D. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.

7. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

9. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

10. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

11. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

12. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

3. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. D — Information and Communication Technology

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

8. C — CPU

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
